title: Lineage IV foundational body plan
scope: Lineage-level body plan of Lineage IV, the fully aquatic flexible-trunk fin-fan lineage, distinguishing its ancestral core from the mass breeder's derived specialisations. Species, names, taxonomy, sizes, branch inventory, fin-fan counts, which branches carry derived organs, reproduction, distribution, senses, feeding, Mana patterns, and local presence remain open. No accepted mass-breeder claim is altered.
approval_evidence: After the A/B/C ancestral-scope cards were presented with A recommended, the Author selected 'A — Trunk-and-fan core' on 2026-08-17.
question: What is Lineage IV's lineage-level body plan, and how much of the mass breeder's anatomy is ancestral rather than its own specialisation?
selection: Trunk-and-fan core: Lineage IV is fully aquatic throughout and spans the full aquatic size and niche range, with a lineage-wide inheritance of a laterally flexible trunk on springy cartilage-analogue support, paired fin-fans as primary control surfaces, a muscular tail for propulsion, and aquatic respiration through fold surfaces. The mass breeder's three-pair fin-fan count, wedge-shaped mineralised head shield, dedicated ion-exchange organs, and wax-like-gel chambers are derived and branch-specific, making it one specialised migratory member rather than the lineage template.
alternatives: L4-CORE-A: trunk-and-fan locomotor core ancestral, mass-breeder specialisations derived; selected.
L4-CORE-B: the full mass-breeder package ancestral; not selected (narrow, uniformly over-equipped lineage).
L4-CORE-C: minimal aquatic-plus-fin-fans core; not selected (lineage stops describing a body plan).
rationale: The trunk-and-fan core gives the lineage a real, recognisable body plan without conscripting every future member into the mass breeder's specialised equipment, respects WLD-ECOLOGY-007's explicit refusal to fix taxonomic rank, invariant morphology, or related-organism range, and reserves shields, salt organs, and gel chambers as costed adaptations that appear where they are earned.
consequences: Lineage IV members share a flexible trunk, springy support, paired fin-fans, muscular tail, and fold respiration.
Head shields, salt organs, and gel chambers are derived adaptations, not lineage-wide inheritance.
The mass breeder is repositioned as a specialised migratory member without any change to its own records.
A fully aquatic lineage is bounded by water connectivity, making route geography ecologically load-bearing for it.
Later Lineage IV branch and species development must build on this core.
No Earth homology, particular species, or System mechanic is created.
residual_unknowns: Species, names, taxonomy, sizes, and branch inventory remain open.
Fin-fan counts and arrangements outside the mass breeder's three pairs remain open.
Which branches carry shields, ion-exchange organs, or gel chambers remains open.
Reproduction across the lineage remains open; the mass breeder's mass spawning is its own.
Freshwater, brackish, and marine distribution remains open.
Senses, feeding, cognition, Mana patterns beyond the mass breeder's bounded case, and local presence remain open.
reopening_conditions: The trunk-and-fan core cannot support a needed aquatic design.
A concrete contradiction with an accepted or provisional record emerges.
The Author explicitly reopens the decision.
